An apicoectomy is a specialized endodontic procedure aimed at treating infection or inflammation after the root canal treatment has failed. At smile dental arts centre in Markham this process is done to save a tooth that might need to be extracted. During an apicoectomy, the dentist makes a small incision in the gum tissue to access the root and remove any infected tissue or abscess. This is often done by sealing the root canal to prevent infections in the future.

The procedure begins with a local anaesthetic to ensure the patient is comfortable and pain-free. The dentist at smile dental arts centre then performs the incision and removes the infected tissue. In some cases, a small filling is placed in the root to seal it. This careful approach makes sure the tooth is functional. An apicoectomy offers significant benefits for patients who have persistent issues after a root canal treatment, at smile dental arts centre in Markham this process addresses and fixes infections or inflammation at the tip of the root. By removing the infected tissue and sealing the root an apicoectomy saves the natural tooth, preserving its functionality and appearance of it. This action is preferable to extraction.

The advantage of an apicoectomy is that it helps the integrity of teeth and jawbone. By preserving the tooth, this procedure stops the moving of adjacent and near teeth. This contributes to better long-term oral health and stability. Smile dental arts centre uses state-of-the-art technology to perform these procedures with precision, minimizing the impact on surrounding issues.

Once you are numb and relaxed, the dentist makes an incision in the gum tissue near the root of the tooth to access the bone underneath.

The next step involves removing the infected tissue at the tip of the tooth root. This is done carefully to eliminate any bacteria and decay that could cause an infection. After the infection is removed the end of the tooth root is cleaned with some material. This sealing with biocompatible material is done to prevent infection and long-term durability of the tooth. The area is cleaned to remove any debris afterwards.

Brushing and flossing help control the plaque and bacteria that cause dental disease.

Plaque is a film of food debris, bacteria, and saliva that sticks to the teeth and gums. The bacteria in plaque convert certain food particles into acids that cause tooth decay. Also, if plaque is not removed, it turns into calculus (tartar). If plaque and calculus are not removed, they begin to destroy the gums and bone, causing periodontal (gum) disease.
Plaque formation and growth is continuous and can only be controlled by regular brushing, flossing, and the use of other dental aids.
Toothbrushing – Brush your teeth at least twice a day (especially before going to bed at night) with an ADA approved soft bristle brush and toothpaste.

Electric toothbrushes are also recommended. They are easy to use and can remove plaque efficiently. Simply place the bristles of the electric brush on your gums and teeth and allow the brush to do its job, several teeth at a time.

Flossing – Daily flossing is the best way to clean between the teeth and under the gumline. Flossing not only helps clean these spaces, it disrupts plaque colonies from building up, preventing damage to the gums, teeth, and bone.

dental-services/endodontics.heading: Endodontics
paragraphs: Endodontics is a field of dentistry which is focused on treating issues that may happen in the tooth, involving the pulp and surrounding tissues. At smile dental arts centre in Markham, root canal therapy services are offered to those patients in need. Root canal therapy is usually done to save teeth that have become infected or inflamed. Advanced imaging technology is used such as digital X-rays and 3d imaging to diagnose the condition of the tooth.
The root canal procedure involves removing the infected or damaged pulp, cleaning and disinfecting the root canal system and then sealing the canal with specific material.

Endodontics is a branch of dentistry that involves diagnosing preventing and treating diseases that are related to the inside of the teeth also known as the pulp, the dental pulp is the soft inner part of the tooth containing nerves blood vessels and connective tissues. When the pulp is damaged due to decay or infection. Endodontic treatment is necessary to repair and save the tooth. Endodontic services are offered as a part of our dental surgery in the Markham program.

Root canal treatment is a common treatment that is used to save a tooth when it is severely damaged or infected, at smile dental arts centre in Markham, root canal treatment involves removing infected dental pulp which is the soft tissue inside the tooth that contains blood vessels and nerves. When a pulp becomes infected due to decay or trauma it can cause extreme pain and lead to many different complications and issues. The root canal treatment cleans the area, the inner part of the tooth, eliminating the infection and saving the tooth.

The process of the root canal procedure starts with assessing the damage using imaging tools. This step is needed to determine the extent of the infection and to check for damages in the structure of the tooth’s canals. Once the dentist identifies the condition, the surrounding area of the tooth is numbed with anaesthesia before attempting the treatment.

During the root canal procedure, the dentist creates an opening in the top of the tooth to access the infected pulp which contains blood vessels and nerves. Some instruments are used to remove the damaged pulp inside the tooth. This removal is essential because it eliminates the infection and prevents it from spreading further.

The inside of the tooth is cleaned and disinfected to ensure all bacteria are eliminated. At smile dental arts centre in Markham, the use of modern equipment helps us to make this process more efficient. They are reducing the duration of this process and the risk of further infections.

Root amputation known as root resection is a specialised process that is performed when one root of a multi-rooted tooth becomes infected or damaged. At smile dental arts centre in Markham, root amputation is considered an alternative to tooth extraction in cases where a root canal treatment cannot solve the issue. The overall goal of this process is to keep the natural tooth by only removing the problematic infected root.

This process is often done on teeth that have multiple roots. Before performing a root amputation, the dental team at smile dental arts centre assesses to check the amount of damage done to the area. If only one root is damaged and the whole structure of the tooth can be saved then the root amputation process can begin.
This process begins with anaesthesia to numb the area to ensure patient comfort, then the dentist carefully removes the affected root while keeping the healthy parts of the teeth intact.

paragraphs: Prosthodontics focuses on the restoration and replacement of missing or damaged teeth. At smile dental arts centre the prosthodontics services improve the functionality and aesthetics of your oral health. Allowing our patients to chew speak and smile with confidence.

At smile dental arts centre in Markham, there is attention to both form and function. The prosthetic devices such as crowns or bridges are carefully made to blend in with your current teeth.

Crowns are dental restorations used to cover damaged or decayed teeth, restoring the shape size strength, and appearance of your teeth. The custom-crafted caps are designed to cover the visible parts of the teeth.

Crowns are typically made from durable materials such as ceramic or porcelain, depending on the needs of the patient the material can change. The ideal solution for teeth that have been made weak by large fillings, fractures, or root canal treatments.

At smile dental arts centre in Markham, patients have access to different types of crown options, selected based on the needs of the patients for the patients that need more natural aesthetics. We offer full porcelain all ceramic crowns that blend with other teeth. These crowns are well suited for front teeth where aesthetics are a great priority.

Several dental crowns are available, at smile dental arts centre in Markham. Porcelain fused to metal (PFM), all-ceramic, all-porcelain, and metal crowns. PFM crowns offer the strength of the metal with the appearance of porcelain, making them a great choice for front and back teeth. Fully ceramic or fully porcelain crowns offer great aesthetics and are great for patients who are allergic to metal crowns. Or those who seek natural-looking results. Metal crowns however are made from other alloys, they are known for their durability and are used for molar teeth where strength is the most important factor.

Unlike dentures or bridges, dental implants provide unparalleled stability and durability. They fuse directly with the bone, offering long-term support for chewing and speaking.

Dental implant placement is a multi-step process that needs careful planning to ensure a great outcome. At smile dental arts centre in Markham, the process begins with a detailed consultation, during this consultation dentist checks the patient’s oral health and overall suitability for implants. Imaging technology is used to create a treatment plan. Ensuring that the implant is placed in its optimal position. If the patient doesn’t have enough bone density, bone grafting may be necessary to provide a strong foundation for the implant.

We are delighted to offer Pocket Reduction Surgery as part of our advanced periodontal care services. At Smile Dental Art Centre, we are committed to providing our patients with the latest and most effective treatments for gum disease and overall oral health.

Pocket Reduction Surgery, also known as Gingival Flap Surgery, is a specialized procedure performed by our skilled periodontists to treat advanced gum disease, also known as periodontitis. In this surgical procedure, the gum tissue is gently folded back, allowing our experts to access and thoroughly clean the roots of the teeth and remove bacteria and tartar that have accumulated in deep gum pockets. The gum tissue is then repositioned, reducing the pocket depth and promoting gum tissue reattachment to the teeth.

At Smile Dental Art Centre, your oral health is our top priority. Our experienced periodontists are skilled in performing Pocket Reduction Surgery with precision and care.
